title: Inflation: Cause and Effect
grammar: Cause and Result in an Inflation Analysis
goal: I can say what one price change causes with *ami* (*a bérek nőnek, ami az árakat is növeli*).
I can tell core inflation, disinflation and a price-wage spiral apart.
I can name the main terms of an inflation analysis (*maginfláció, költségoldali sokk, keresleti nyomás*).
